title: BUG: C_GetAttributeValue returns CKR_OK for unknown attributes
description: wp11_pkcs11.c:1973-1977: the default case of the attribute switch sets pTemplate[i].ulValueLen = CK_UNAVAILABLE_INFORMATION and falls through to return CKR_OK. PKCS#11 2.40 Section 11.7 requires that when an attribute type does not exist on the object, the function set ulValueLen = CK_UNAVAILABLE_INFORMATION AND return CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID (not CKR_OK). Callers that check only the return code — including many PKCS#11 middleware implementations — would interpret CKR_OK as meaning all requested attributes were successfully returned. This can silently break attribute filtering in applications like OpenSSL's pkcs11 engine and p11-kit. Fix: track whether any unsupported attributes were seen in the loop; if so, return CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID after processing all entries (not mid-loop, so partial results for supported attributes are still written to the template).
